title: integration ha_event
description: Hub -> integration push session only. An event of the taxonomy with source hub (pairing, guests, profiles, adjustments, kids release request); the integration fires it as <ns>_event (and as <ns>_alarm for alarm kinds) unchanged. Other kinds are ignored (the integration fires those itself), except a test (data.test true, “Send test” of a notification rule), which the integration fires for any kind of the taxonomy with test true. Fire-and-forget, nothing is queued while the integration session is down.
